Battery-save tests use fresh emulator processes and dedicated on-disk NVRAM; high-score/config fixtures are explicitly injected before normal menu confirmation or game-over finalization.
The previous base-port long-run reports are retained with their original ROM identity under out/before-survival-sram.
Physical console/cart/flashcart persistence and PAL timing are not verified.
